verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a payments platform that ships SDKs, an agent toolkit and a hosted MCP server, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The agent toolkit's optional lifecycle callbacks only let developers record their own tool metrics; they do not control SumUp's data collection, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
